decontamination_notes: Real feature from encode/starlette PR #3431, merged 2026-08-08 — one of the latest merges available when this task was built (2026-08-23), deliberately chosen to sit past any plausible training cutoff; re-check upstream_merged against any newer model's cutoff before reusing. Human-authored by a starlette maintainer (Kludex). Adds configurable request-body size limits: a new starlette/middleware/body_limit.py (RequestBodyLimitMiddleware plus a receive-wrapping responder that counts bytes as they arrive), threaded through applications.py (constructor kwarg + placement in the middleware stack between the server-error and exception middleware), routing.py (Router, Mount and Route kwargs), and formparsers.py (broadened cleanup so files opened during a parse are closed when the limit aborts it). Architecture complexity: the fix is a cross-cutting ASGI concern, not a localized edit — the byte counting has to happen in the receive channel, and a Content-Length-only implementation is wrong. Repo sliced at the PR base commit (9c500db1) to the starlette package + pyproject + LICENSE; deps come from the per-task image vulcanbench/sandbox:starlette-3431 (anyio, httpx for TestClient, python-multipart; starlette itself deliberately absent so PYTHONPATH=. resolves the workspace copy). Coverage: 6 fail_to_pass tests, each verified failing at base and passing after the gold patch — app-level limit, route-level limit (and non-interference with unlimited sibling routes), mount-level limit, the standalone middleware on a raw ASGI app, a STREAMED body with no Content-Length (which a header-only limiter lets through), and multipart uploads counting toward the limit. 9 pass_to_pass guards are the tail mechanism: because a failing guard zeroes the functional score, a limiter that swallows streaming bodies, breaks urlencoded/multipart parsing, disturbs the middleware stack (exception handlers, background tasks), or caps unlimited apps scores 0.0 rather than a partial. Assertions check status codes and endpoint-computed values only, never framework message text.
